name: Beaded Floral Abaya — Black
description: Timeless beauty meets delicate artistry in our signature black abaya. Crafted from premium flowy fabric that drapes beautifully with every step, featuring a stunning sheer side panel adorned with hand crafted embroidery. Finished with delicate sparkling detailing on the sleeves. Also includes a matching black hijab with bead detailing on the edge.

name: Embroidered Cuff Abaya — Blush Pink
description: A floor-length closed abaya in a blush pink colour with a clean, centered front seam and wide flowing sleeves, finished with intricate gold and cream floral embroidery along the cuffs. Paired with a matching hijab for timeless modest elegance.

name: Buttoned Lace Abaya — Black
description: A button-front abaya in deep black with a flattering V-neckline, finished with intricate black lace trim at the flared cuffs and matching fabric buttons down the placket. A quietly elegant everyday piece. Also comes with a matching black hijab.

name: Embroidered Vine Abaya — Mauve
description: A graceful open-front abaya in soft mauve, adorned with intricate white floral vine embroidery along the front and sleeves. Finished with delicate scalloped edges and a matching draped hijab for timeless modest elegance.

name: Embroidered Sleeve Abaya — Black
description: A striking open-front abaya in black, that can also be worn closed. It has intricate floral embroidery in soft cream and tan tones on the sleeves. Timeless modest luxury with an artfully finished scalloped edge. Also comes with a matching black hijab.

name: Closed Satin Abaya — Black
description: A minimalist plain closed abaya in black satin for everyday wear. Paired with a matching black scarf for a clean, timeless silhouette.

name: Lace Cuff Abaya — Beige
description: A button-front abaya in Beige with a flattering V-neckline, finished with intricate Beige lace trim at the flared cuffs and matching fabric buttons down the placket. A quietly elegant everyday piece. Also comes with a matching beige hijab to finish the look.

name: Satin Open Abaya — Chocolate
description: A floor-length Open abaya in rich chocolate-brown satin, with a lustrous sheen and relaxed flowing fit. Wide sleeves and a matching hijab completes this Abaya.

name: Satin Open Abaya — Navy
description: Cut from fluid navy satin with a soft lustrous sheen, this floor-length abaya drapes with effortless elegance. A matching hijab completes the look, finished with wide sleeves and a clean, minimal silhouette.

name: Silver Stone Embellished Abaya — Dark Brown
description: A rich dark brown fabric abaya, scattered with delicate silver stone embellishments on the front and the back, balances quiet luxury with subtle artistry. Wide flared sleeves, with brown bead detailing on the cuff to give it that dressed up look for an occasion. Comes with a matching hijab to finish the look.

name: Minimalist Closed Abaya — Khaki
description: A floor-length closed abaya in a beautiful shade of khaki on satin fabric, with a lustrous sheen and relaxed flowing fit. Wide sleeves and a matching hijab completes this Abaya.

name: Embroidered Piping Abaya — Black
description: A striking black abaya illuminated by delicate white floral embroidery tracing the sleeves, framed with crisp white piping down the front. Paired effortlessly with a black hijab, it's a statement of quiet sophistication.

name: Beaded Lace Abaya — Black
description: Timeless black elegance, our signature abaya with hand embellished front panels and delicate sparkling details along the front and the sleeves. The fabric is a flowy chiffon material with a matching plain black slip and a matching hijab. Also comes with a belt, making it a stunning four piece abaya.

name: Embroidered Sleeve Abaya — Cocoa
description: A striking open-front abaya in a deep cocoa brown shade, that can also be worn closed. It has intricate floral embroidery in soft beige and white tones on the sleeves. Timeless modest luxury with an artfully finished scalloped edge. Finish the look with a matching hijab.
